mentions.name: NumPad
mentions.description: Web-based notepad calculator that lets users write text and calculations together. Version 2 adds user accounts, multiple documents, markdown support, and document exports, with local-first storage and CRDT-based document syncing. Currently in unstable beta testing.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I launched my web-based notepad calculator, https://numpad.io/, a few years ago.

Right now I'm working on a version 2 that has user accounts, multiple documents, markdown support, and document exports. Everything is local-first and it uses CRDTs to sync documents.
